name: Motion Archery
summary: 3D archery game where you hold your phone like a bow and the front camera tracks your hand on-device for a real pinch, draw and release (touch hold-to-draw option). Features 100 challenges across 10 worlds, 1v1 online PvP duels with friend codes, 4 bows with real arrow physics, a slow-motion arrow cam and 6 practice ranges. Free with ads.
